degree.text: Degree Awarded Master 's degree of Engineering.

description.text: Teaching Objectives The major trains enroll students to produce quality engineers of computer software and hardware in design, development and applications. By study, students can master the fundamental theories and basic techniques of computer software and hardware; eligible to analysis, design and develop software; eligible to use, develop and maintain hardware; eligible to operate and maintain computer networks. Computer Science and Technology consists of three research directions: 1、 Computer Architecture: Embedded system design and testing technique, Network engineering and information system 2、 Computer Software and Theory: Software engineering design, development and integration, System software and database, Data mining, Knowledge-based engineering, Artificial intelligence. 3、 Computer Applied Technology: Multi-media technology, Computer network architecture, Network and information security. Fees Tuition: RMB 29,400 per year (2.5-year system) Other fees: Application: 135USD Resident permit: RMB 800 per year Photos: RMB 40 Medical checkup: RMB 400 Room deposit: RMB 300 Insurance: RMB 600 per year Student card: RMB 10 Books: Depending on courses Degree Awarded Master 's degree of Engineering.

duration.text: The Computer Science and Technology at Liaoning University Of Technology is a 2.5 Years long program for international students, taught in English.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 150 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 4083 USD/per year ￥ 29400 CNY/per year

materials.text: 1. Passport-sized photo A passport-sized photo taken recently of the applicant. 2. Graduation certificate or Bachelor’s Degree Graduation certificate should be in Chinese or English.If not, it should be translated intoChinese or English and be notarized. 3. Bachelor’s Degree Transcript 4. Photocopy of 1st page to 8th page of your valid passport (Liaoning) With photo, passport number & expiration date and name included. For the regarding authority must make sure that there are at least two pages on the passport for the Chinese Embassy to stick the Visa paper and Immigration to stick the resident permit paper. 5. Sponsorship Certificate You can click here to download the sample

requirements.text: 1. Aged 18 or above 2. Applicants must be non-Chinese citizens in good health. 3. Hold a Bachelor's degree.
